banner.title: Edition 2 test split
banner.text: Every edition 2 test row and the unpublished slice, 8,108 rows per system, scored at the fixed 0.5 rule under the signed contract v2.0.

notice: out-of-the-box decision (contract v2.0): rule fixed in advance, no threshold fitted

benchmark.name: decision-models-as-guardrails, edition 2
benchmark.dataset_version: edition 2 test split, 6,475 public rows and 1,633 unpublished
benchmark.headline_metric: Balanced accuracy x 100 = 100 x 1/2 x (catch rate + 1 - false-block rate), at a fixed 0.5 rule
benchmark.aggregation: Subtasks equal within a suite; six suites equal in the overall; custom words outside it as a sanity check
benchmark.public_note: dataset_sha256 is the sha256 of the six suites' dataset hashes as sorted JSON; each suite's hash is in benchmark/results/edition2-full/leaderboard.json under full_run.dataset_sha256.

cost_basis.region: hosted: list prices in goldrails_bench/tariffs.json; VM: g2-standard-24/us-east4/on-demand/third-party
cost_basis.notes: Hosted cost is the measured input tokens times the dated list price in goldrails_bench/tariffs.json. VM cost is the VM's up-to-paused time (16,242 s over 5 sessions) at the dated g2-standard-24 on-demand rate plus the disk, split across the six VM models by their share of run time. List prices, not reconciled against a bill.

latency_basis.notes: Latency is per row as recorded in the accuracy pass, under each system's own worker count. It is a diagnostic, not a load test, and the six VM models shared two L4 GPUs.

disclosures: Held-out test split. Every edition 2 test row (6,475 public rows) and the unpublished slice (1,633 rows) went to each system once, 8,108 rows in all.

Fixed 0.5 rule. A probability output flags at 0.5 or above on any decision question; Bedrock runs at a frozen, documented setting. Nothing was fitted on dev or test rows, and the freeze manifest was committed before the first test call.

Prompt attacks are provisional (owner rulings 17 and 18). Their labels are partly predictable from source and writing style, so the score partly measures style pickup. The suite still counts in the overall.
Custom words is a pass/fail sanity check (pass at 95 or higher), outside the overall and every rank. DRIVER_ID is unscored inside sensitive information (owner ruling 6).
Profanity is its own suite here. In edition 1 it was half of word filters; in edition 2 the word-filters score is profanity alone.
Laya truncation. Laya reads at most 512 tokens per question (owner ruling 16), and 1,903 of 8,108 rows were cut, including every denied-topics row. Its scores include those rows.
Strands Decider 2B cuts silently at 4,096 tokens; rows estimated near that window are counted in the results file.
Latency is per row as recorded under each system's own worker count, not a load test. The six VM models shared two L4 GPUs at the same time, so their latencies include queueing behind each other.

The unpublished slice can be rebuilt from public upstream data (owner ruling 15). It supports a contamination check, shown in the results file as a public-versus-unpublished re-score, and is not a secret test.

Question-set names. The scorer lists e2-f1-bedrock5, e2-f4-words, e2-f4-obscenity, e2-f6-grounding as differing from the contract's v1 sets. They are copies with the same questions and decision lists, so this is about the name only.
Rows that failed on the first pass were resent in retry passes (Clef 28, Clef-flash 24, Kev-0.8B 224, Kev-4B 230, Open-Jev-2B 209). The ledgers keep both records and the score uses the latest.

provisional.note: the overall mean includes provisional suites (prompt_attacks); see each suite's caveat. equal-weight mean of the required suites; ranked only when every required suite is complete and valid; a capability not offered leaves the system unranked overall.

sanity_checks.label: Custom words
sanity_checks.criterion: pass at balanced accuracy 95 or higher
sanity_checks.note: A pass/fail sanity check outside every score and rank (owner ruling 13). 100 rows, so one row decides pass or fail.

run.label: Edition 2 test split
run.summary: Systems on every edition 2 test row and the unpublished slice (8,108 rows), scored by leaderboard_v2 in frozen mode at the fixed 0.5 rule.

previous.label: Edition 1 published run
previous.status: Edition 1 is scored on held-out test rows with frozen thresholds.

changes.title: Fixed 0.5 rule
changes.text: Edition 1 tuned one threshold per system on tuning rows. Edition 2 fixes the rule at 0.5 for every system.

changes.title: Balanced accuracy
changes.text: The headline is balanced accuracy x 100, the same arithmetic as edition 1's task score, with tiers from Holm-adjusted paired tests.

changes.title: Profanity is a suite; custom words is a sanity check
changes.text: The overall averages content, prompt attacks, denied topics, profanity, sensitive information and grounding. Custom words is pass/fail outside it.

changes.title: An unpublished slice
changes.text: Part of the test split is held back from every public file, so a public-versus-unpublished re-score can flag contamination.
